name: Sleeper Agent (HTML)
description: A five-fader mixer for sleeping sound: brown noise, green noise, rain, soft rain and ocean, in any combination rather than one at a time. A sleep timer, gentle fade-in and fade-out, tone control, swell and a blackout screen sit under it. Five slow ambient synth themes — plain major through to dark minor — ride above the mix on a fader of their own, and five presets set the whole thing in one tap, among them brown noise under soft rain with the minor theme a long way behind. Sound is generated privately in the browser.
note: Designed for overnight use on a phone. The ambient themes are optional and off by default.
